races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Race
races.verdict: CRAYONS IN THE SKY made no mistake when justifying odds-on favouritism with a bit in hand over C&D recently and Stephen Thorne's filly can confirm her superiority over Normanton , who showed much more than on debut last time and is open to further improvement. I Ready and Supreme Lord can fight out the minor placings. CRAYONS IN THE SKY NORMANTON (IRE) I READY (IRE)

races.title: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict: Cases can be made for plenty of these so it could pay to take a chance on DAAMBERDIPLOMAT , who was last seen in winning action here in October last year and returns from just 1 lb higher having since joined the shrewd Ado McGuinness outfit. Caffu Zafeen arrives in search of a 5-timer, so he merits considerable respect, with All The Girls and Eddie G another couple worth considering, as well. DAAMBERDIPLOMAT (IRE) CAFFU ZAFEEN (IRE) ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)

races.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Proud Supporter Of Irish Racing' Maiden
races.verdict: In a maiden where few arrive with compelling claims last month's Gowran runner-up SANGREAL is taken to go one better at the expense of fellow 3-y-o filly Kashala , who is open to further progress after only 2 starts. Theorist may prove best of the remainder if a return to polytrack sees him recapture the form he showed here at this time last year. SANGREAL (IRE) KASHALA (IRE) THEORIST (IRE)

races.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight' Handicap
races.verdict: ANVIKA failed to finish through no fault of her own at the Curragh last month, having clipped heels and unseated her rider, so she's well worth another chance to supplement her recent Curragh success given she remains well treated on old form. Serenity Blue ought to go well again, while his stablemate Star Harbour is also of interest returning to all-weather. ANVIKA (IRE) SERENITY BLUE STAR HARBOUR (IRE)
